findings.reason: the write paths must gain `reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py` (or the deliverable must state that the before-read is deliberately left alone), otherwise the node cannot deliver a write response whose two coverage readings agree.
findings.text: §44's deliverable requires "the write response and admission [to] compute coverage through one call with the same inputs", but the write response's `uncovered_by_write` is a difference of two coverage reads, and its before-reader is `_uncovered_before_write` (`reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:2195`, whose result is passed at :2244 into `_review_owed_fields(uncovered_before=…)`), a module §44 does not name in its write paths, so a worker either leaves that read on its own input — the same split one field over, in the very response the section is about — or must breach its declared scope
